intro: Here's our story! The moon is missing three little lights. Let's follow the glowing seeds, cross the Wishing River, and bring them home. Are you ready?
seeds: Look! Three sleepy glow seeds. Tap each one to wake it up. Their little lights will help the moon shine again.
seed2: Two lights! You're making the forest sparkle.
seedsDone: We found all three! Even the smallest light can make a big difference. Let's follow the path to the Wishing River.
bridge: Oh! The stepping stones have drifted away. Put them back in order. One, two, three. You can tap them, or drag them to the matching spaces.
bridgeWrong: Let's start with the next number. We can do it together!
bridgeDone: Three! You built a way across. Come on, explorer. The moon is waiting for us.
moon: We made it to the moon gate! Who lights up the night sky? Is it the sun, or the moon? Tap your answer, or tell me out loud.
moonWrong: The sun shines in the daytime. Who comes out at night? Try the other one!
moonDone: The moon! That's right. Let's send our little lights up to the sky.
outro: Look! The moon is glowing again. You helped the forest, built a bridge, and brought back the light. Thank you for playing with me. Until our next adventure!
unclear: I couldn't hear that clearly. You can try again, or tap your answer.
hintSeeds: Find the three glowing seeds. Tap one to give it a little sparkle.
hintBridge: Look for the next number, then tap it. One, two, three.
hintMoon: Think about the night sky. What do you see when the sun has gone to sleep?
helloName: Hello! I'm Sparky. I'm so happy you're here! What's your name?
nameCheck: Did I hear your name right?
nameWelcome: That's a lovely name. It's really nice to meet you! How are you feeling today?
nameRetry: Let's try again. You can tell me your first name, or type it here.
nameSkip: That's okay! You can be my explorer friend. How are you feeling today?
moodHappy: Happy! Me too! Look, even my little flames are doing a happy dance!
moodExcited: Excited! Ooh, I think we're going to have so much fun together!
moodSleepy: A little sleepy? That's okay. We can take our time. A gentle adventure might wake up our smiles.
moodShy: Feeling a little shy? That's okay. I'm right here with you. We can explore together.
favoriteColor: Let's get to know each other! My favourite colour is warm, sunny orange. What's your favourite colour?
colorRed: Red! Like a bright, juicy strawberry. I like that!
colorBlue: Blue! Like a big, beautiful sky. I like that!
colorGreen: Green! Like our lovely little garden. I like that!
colorYellow: Yellow! Like a little ray of sunshine. I like that!
colorOrange: Orange! That's my favourite too. We match!
colorPurple: Purple! Like the soft evening sky. That's a lovely choice!
inviteStory: Would you like to come on a little adventure with me? We can help the moon find its missing lights. Or we can stay here and play first.
playTogether: Let's play copy me! Give me a little wave. Now tap my little spark when you're ready!
waveDone: Hello, hello! That was fun. Shall we go and help the moon now?
welcomeBack: Hello again, my explorer friend! I'm so happy you're back. Shall we keep exploring, or have a little chat first?
conversationUnclear: I didn't quite catch that. Could you try once more? You can also choose one of the pictures.
conversationSilence: Take your time. I'm right here. You can tell me, or tap a choice.
howFeeling: How are you feeling today, my friend?
mapWelcome: This is our little world! Where shall we go? Tap a place, and I'll come with you. We can always come back and choose somewhere else.
mapReturn: That was fun! Where would you like to go next?
gardenDone: You found it! That was a lovely little game. We make a good team!
gardenWrong: Let's have another look. Find the colour I asked for.
allLights: Look at all the little lights we found together! Shall we send them up to the moon?
gardenRed: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a red glow seed. Can you tap the red one?
gardenBlue: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a blue glow seed. Can you tap the blue one?
gardenGreen: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a green glow seed. Can you tap the green one?
gardenYellow: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a yellow glow seed. Can you tap the yellow one?
gardenOrange: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a orange glow seed. Can you tap the orange one?
gardenPurple: Welcome to our play garden! Let's find a purple glow seed. Can you tap the purple one?
worldWelcome: Come explore with me! Tap a path. I'll follow you. Each little house has games inside!
worldBack: Welcome back, my friend! Where shall we play next?
worldWin: You did really well! Shall we learn something different?
hubHome: We're home! Would you like to talk with me, or go and explore?
offerLetters: The storybook house! Shall we play with pictures, letters, or words? You choose!
offerNumbers: Let's count! Pick the beads, the apples, or the little ducklings.
offerColours: So many lovely colours! Tap the palette. Let's match them!
offerPuzzles: Build a picture? Or spot a difference? Pick one!
offerPicnic: Time for a picnic! Feed me something yummy, or play dress-up with our friends!
goLetters: Let's visit the storybook house! Come along with me.
goNumbers: Let's go to the counting mill. I'll show you the way!
goColours: Let's see what's growing in the colour garden!
goPuzzles: A puzzle adventure! Let's find the grotto together.
goPicnic: Come on! Let's have a little picnic and play.
goHome: Let's go home for a little hello.
worldRoam: Here I come! I love exploring with you.
worldOffer: What looks fun? Tap a house. I'll come with you!
worldWait: Take your time. Which picture looks fun?
worldLoading: Our game is getting ready. Just a little moment!
worldLoadError: That game couldn't wake up just yet. Let's go back, or try again.
worldMicHelp: You can tell me letters, numbers, colours, puzzles, picnic, or home. Where would you like to go?
worldNoHear: I didn't quite hear that. Try saying a place, or tap one. I'll come with you!
funHello: Hello, hello! I'm so happy we're playing together!
funTickle: Hee hee! That tickles my little sparks!
funWave: A big little wave, just for you! Can you wave back?
funHop: Boing! Did you see my little hop? Your turn!
funDance: Wiggle, wiggle, little spark! Let's do a tiny happy dance!
funJoke1: What did one little flame say to another? You're a bright friend! Hee hee!
funJoke2: Why did the teddy bear skip dessert? Because it was already stuffed!
funJoke3: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore!
funFriend: I'm Sparky, your little exploring friend! I love games, silly jokes, and playing with you.
funFeeling: I'm feeling bright and bouncy today! Being here with you makes me happy.
funGentle: We can take our time. I'm right here with you. Shall we try something gentle together?
funBye: Bye for now, my friend! I'll be here when you're ready for another adventure.
funBall: Ooh, a ball! Boing, boing! Can you tap it again?
funButterfly: Hello, little butterfly! Look at those lovely wings. Where are you flying?
funGift: A little surprise! What could be inside? Sparkles! Just for you!
funFlower: Listen! This flower can sing. Shall we make a little tune?
funBalloon: Up, up, and away! There goes our little star balloon!
funExplore: There are little surprises all around us! Try tapping a flower, a butterfly, or that shiny gift.
funFollow: I'm coming! Let's see what we find together.
funHighFive: High five, my friend! We make a spark-tastic team!
afterTry: Nice trying, my friend! Shall we play something different?
afterLearn: Great work! Ready to learn something new? Pick a picture!
placeGrowing: Look! Your little play place is growing!
placeFavourite: You love playing here! Look, we've made a cosy little corner just for you!
offerFavourite: Your cosy corner! Shall we play one of your favourite games?
missionExplore: A little adventure! Bounce the ball, visit a house, and finish a game. Let's do it together!
missionHelper: Let's find a surprise, ring a flower, and try a game in a different place!
missionFriend: Say hello to the butterfly! Then let's explore and play!
missionComplete: Our little mission is done! You did so well! Ready to learn something new?
missionBall: Let's find the beach ball. Give it a tap. Boing!
missionGift: Can you find the little gift? Tap it. Let's see what's inside!
missionFlower: Let's make the flowers sing. Tap a bell flower!
missionButterfly: Let's say hello to our butterfly friend!
missionGame: Let's play a game together! Pick a picture!
